Reusable Agent Contexts -- reusable input boundary for editing and evaluations
|-- AgentContext: validated conversation value (agentContext.ts)
|   |-- Capture a trajectory slice
|   |   |-- Walk parents from throughEntryId back to fromEntryId; reverse into conversation order
|   |   |-- Reject duplicate entry IDs, cycles, missing entries and ranges spanning branches
|   |   `-- fromMessages builds a linear trajectory with diagram-composer provenance
|   |-- Preserve message structure
|   |   |-- user / assistant / toolResult -> ordered content blocks
|   |   |-- Blocks: text, pinned sourceRange, or one named section of text/source ranges
|   |   |-- Assistant may also contain toolCall blocks
|   |   `-- Tool history must be complete
|   |       |-- Unique call IDs; each result must match a pending call ID and tool name
|   |       `-- All pending results must arrive before the next non-result message or slice end
|   |-- Snapshot identity
|   |   |-- source + selected range + messages + version -> canonical JSON -> SHA-256 contentHash
|   |   |-- Version: 1 = basic content; 2 = source ranges; 3 = named sections
|   |   |-- sourceFiles attachments are excluded from the descriptor hash
|   |   |   `-- Each attachment has its own hash; reject mismatches and unreferenced files
|   |   `-- Validate imported hashes and history; clone snapshots; enforce 16 MiB input bound
|   `-- Resolve for model input
|       |-- sourceRange -> attached snapshot bytes, otherwise supplied source reader
|       |-- Cache identical references per resolution; missing source -> explicit failure
|       |-- Produce path:lines + selected text; cap expanded source text at 16 MiB
|       |-- Return a newly hashed resolved value; retain section boundaries
|       `-- toPiMessages -> labeled section boundaries + imported-history metadata
|           |-- Unresolved source ranges are rejected
|           `-- Synthetic assistant provenance does not select the run's model
|-- Source pinning: FileAgentContextSources (fileAgentContextSources.ts)
|   |-- Reference contract (agentContextSource.ts)
|   |   |-- Registered sourceId + relative path + inclusive 1-based startLine/endLine
|   |   |-- Version is either Git commit or snapshot contentHash
|   |   `-- Snapshot file = original startLine + lines; requested range must fit
|   |-- Capture through repository/corpus bindings
|   |   |-- Explicit revision, or configured Git binding revision
|   |   |   `-- Resolve revision to commit -> read regular Git blob -> pin commit
|   |   `-- No revision -> read current corpus document
|   |       |-- Git worktree bytes exactly match HEAD file -> pin HEAD commit
|   |       `-- Otherwise -> hash captured file -> store immutable snapshot blob
|   |           `-- Includes changed/untracked files and unborn repositories
|   |-- Read pinned evidence
|   |   |-- Git -> registered binding + commit + path; reject trees, submodules and symlinks
|   |   |-- Snapshot -> immutable blob keyed by hash
|   |   `-- Validate range -> render only selected lines
|   |-- Persist a context
|   |   `-- Validate snapshot -> store attachments -> verify all references -> strip attachments
|   |       `-- Durable descriptor keeps pins; source bytes live separately
|   `-- Export portable evidence
|       |-- Load each distinct reference -> copy only its selected lines with original offset
|       |-- Replace Git/snapshot references with hashes of those selected slices
|       `-- Attach slices -> rebuild context hash
|           `-- Export carries selected evidence without unrelated file lines
|-- AgentContextLibrary: durable reuse (agentContextLibrary.ts)
|   |-- Create explicit context
|   |   |-- Plain text -> one user message
|   |   |-- Text/sourceFile constituents or sections -> capture pins -> one user message
|   |   |-- Supplied snapshot -> validate existing conversation
|   |   `-- Persist sources when adapter exists -> save record -> return summary
|   |       |-- Global ID: saved-agent-context-<request UUID>
|   |       `-- Same request ID + same request hash -> existing result; mismatch -> conflict
|   |-- Read and discover
|   |   |-- Read -> metadata + compact snapshot + optional separate resolvedSnapshot
|   |   |   `-- Resolution preserves the saved snapshot and its contentHash
|   |   `-- List -> case-insensitive name/description filter -> newest first -> paginated summaries
|   |-- Fork and trace lineage
|   |   |-- Check expected parent contentHash -> new saved ID with copied pinned snapshot
|   |   |-- Record parent ID + parent hash; inherit description/group unless overridden
|   |   |-- Comments remain on parent; identical fork retries return the existing fork
|   |   `-- Lineage -> root-to-selected summaries + parentMatches checks
|   |       `-- Missing ancestors or cycles fail explicitly
|   |-- Metadata stays outside model-visible content (savedAgentContext.ts)
|   |   |-- Group can be assigned or cleared without changing snapshot hash
|   |   `-- Comment records text + timestamp + current expected contentHash
|   |       `-- Request UUID deduplicates retries; conflicting reuse or stale hash fails
|   `-- FileAgentContextRepository (fileAgentContextRepository.ts)
|       |-- Store: agent-contexts/<saved ID>.json; global within application store
|       |   `-- Survives restarts; no canvas or chat binding
|       |-- Read -> validate record ID, schema and AgentContext snapshot
|       |-- Create -> write/sync temporary file -> exclusive hard-link publication -> sync directory
|       |   `-- Existing ID must have matching requestHash
|       `-- Metadata update -> per-record directory lock -> read/mutate -> atomic rename
|           `-- Retry lock acquisition up to 5 seconds; release lock and temporary file on exit
`-- Diagram binding (diagramAgentContext.ts)
    |-- Compile stable source evidence once
    |   |-- Evidence originalLines -> hashed snapshot slices + pinned range references
    |   |-- Binding + evidence -> sourceFingerprint
    |   `-- Identity: diagramId + compiledFromRevisionId + sourceFingerprint
    |       `-- Captured evidence is background; each edit request supplies the authoritative current diagram
    |-- Backing representation
    |   |-- Stored -> backingRecordId + contentHash; small reference on diagram
    |   `-- Inline -> snapshot; supported for older workspaces and portable exports
    `-- Store/load validation
        |-- Inline snapshot -> store.put -> hashed backing record ID
        |-- Load -> validate AgentContext and expected contentHash
        `-- Require diagram-context provenance and sourceSessionId matching diagramId
            `-- Missing backing data, mismatched identity or two backing sources -> failure
